results.snippet: **(Kitco News) -** Gold prices ended the U.S. day session with modest losses Monday, but did close up from the daily low scored in early trading. The Cyprus bailout news also put some downside price pressure on the safe-haven gold market, some of which was profit-taking from recent gains. The news rallied the U.S. dollar index and brought gold prices well up from their early daily lows. The crude oil bulls have regained the slight near-term technical advantage, and that favors the gold and silver market bulls. The gold bears have the overall near-term technical advantage. The gold bulls’ next upside near-term price breakout objective is to produce a close above solid technical resistance at last week’s high of $1,616.50. results.title: What Are Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS)?
results.snippet: # What Are Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS)? :max_bytes(150000):strip_icc():format(webp)/gordonscottphoto-5bfc26c446e0fb00265b0ed4.jpg). Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) are a type of Treasury bond that is indexed to an inflationary gauge to protect investors from a decline in the purchasing power of their money. Since you wouldn’t be alone if you did, the U.S. Treasury created Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) in 1997—special government bonds designed to help protect investors when prices rise across the economy. When inflation rises, both the principal amount you invested and the interest payments you receive increase to help maintain your purchasing power.
